- tests/test_log_prefix_regressions.sh:25-57 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The regression test searches `review_autofix.yml` for dispatch log callsites that have moved into step scripts.
  WHY: `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` fails because the workflow no longer contains those echoes.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:249 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The inventory lists `scripts/smoke_review_dispatch.sh`, which is absent from the repository.
  WHY: `tests/inventory_parity.py` fails because the listed script does not exist.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:556 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The gate treats any `[skip ai]` substring in the combined title and body as an intentional skip marker.
  WHY: Quoted, code-fenced, or mid-sentence mentions can silently skip automated review and autofix.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:291 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The sweep treats any `[skip ai]` substring in the title and body as an intentional skip marker.
  WHY: A quoted or code-fenced mention can prevent the catch-all sweep from dispatching review.
- scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py:124 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Candidate selection excludes a PR whenever its title or body contains the `[skip ai]` substring.
  WHY: A quoted or code-fenced mention can keep an eligible PR out of the catch-all fixer sweep.
- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:730-731 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A clean head with no failed check-runs returns `state: open` without detecting a review that never happened.
  WHY: An unreviewed `claude/*` PR can wait indefinitely instead of becoming `review-stalled` and being routed to `hand_back_fixer`.
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:736-737 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The template checker returns `state: open` for a clean head without detecting a review that never happened.
  WHY: Consumer repos can wait indefinitely instead of detecting and handing back a stalled review.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: gate job | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The gate lacks the general skip log and head-bound skip-notice mechanism described for skipped reviews.
  WHY: Most skip reasons remain silent, and the checker and operators cannot see the skipped review trace.
- .claude/scripts/dispatch_workflow.py:61-70 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `DISPATCHABLE_WORKFLOWS` does not include `internal-review.yml`.
  WHY: A fixer attempting to redispatch a stalled review is refused before the workflow API call.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
